work.author: René-Jean Hesbert
work.description: Hesbert's synoptic edition of six early witnesses to the Mass antiphonary: the Gradual of Monza and the antiphonaries of Rheinau, Mont-Blandin, Compiègne, Corbie, and Senlis. Its numbered entries and witness sigla require direct inspection in a materially identified edition before they are treated as verified.
work.title: Antiphonale Missarum Sextuplex
